name: AirPrint to PDF
desc: Print from an iPhone or Mac to the “PDF” printer; the PDFs are listed here.
about: Shows up as a printer called “AirPrint PDF @ <the Pi’s name>” on iPhones and Macs. Whatever you print is saved as a PDF on the Pi, and this page lists them to open or save.

intents.phrase: …turn something on my phone into a PDF
intents.desc: Print to the “AirPrint PDF” printer from an iPhone or Mac and the PDF is saved on the Pi.
